title: Docs updates: retention controls + compliance reporting pack (internal Confluence + external stubs)
creator: Naomi Feldman
content:
## Goal
Update internal + external documentation for the new retention controls and baseline compliance reporting pack. This ticket covers:
- Internal Confluence updates (canonical policy/behavior + evidence procedure references)
- External-facing docs stubs in `redwood-docs` (customer-friendly explanation + how to request/download report pack)
- Security review checklist sign-off (wording, scope boundaries, legal hold semantics)

## Context
Enterprise security reviews (Northbridge Bank / Helio Insurance / Photon Health) are getting blocked on: (1) clear retention behavior by data class + tier, (2) audit log availability and exportability, and (3) a standardized compliance evidence package.

This work needs to stay aligned with:
- Retention policy service behavior (control plane evaluation, change history, export endpoint)
- Audit-log exporter templates and time-windowed filters
- Console retention settings page warnings + permissions model

## Deliverables
### A) Internal Confluence
1) Retention controls overview
- Supported data classes in v1 (request/response logs where stored, audit logs, traces/metrics, report artifacts)
- Tier defaults (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) + min/max TTL constraints
- Clear terminology: TTL vs retention period; purge semantics; “disabled logging” behavior
- Explicitly call out what is *not* included in v1 (e.g., arbitrary field-level redaction)

2) Legal hold + retention exceptions
- Break-glass workflow for incident debugging vs customer-configured short TTL
- Approval matrix + requirement that hold actions are auditable

3) Evidence collection procedure
- Step-by-step for generating: retention config export, audit log export, retention verification metrics screenshots
- Ownership + frequency for internal audits vs customer evidence requests

### B) External docs (`redwood-docs`)
1) Customer-facing “Retention controls” page
- What customers can configure (data classes, TTL/retention windows)
- What Redwood purges automatically, and typical timing semantics (scheduled purge jobs; deletion is eventual but verified)
- How to view change history + export configuration
- Limitations / caveats (e.g., legal hold and incident holds may extend retention; backups/disaster recovery handling explained at high level)

2) Customer-facing “Compliance reporting pack (baseline)” page
- What’s included: audit-log coverage summary, retention configuration export, data residency/region summary, RBAC/access control summary, evidence checklist
- Output formats and versioning statement (export version, backwards compatibility)
- How to request / generate (Console flow and/or Support/Solutions Engineering path for early customers)

3) FAQ updates
- Security questionnaire-friendly Q&A (what do you log, where, for how long; can we configure; can we export; legal hold; data residency)

## Implementation notes / constraints
- Avoid making hard commitments that vary by contract/tier (e.g., exact SLA for report turnaround) unless explicitly approved by Legal + Security.
- Ensure external docs do not expose internal system names, table names, or sensitive operational thresholds.
- Align language with Security & Compliance terminology: “audit logs” vs “request logs”; “retention configuration”; “legal hold”.

## Links
- GitHub (external docs): `sources/github/redwood-docs/pr-1832-document-retention-controls-and-faq.json`
- Design spec: `sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/console-retention-settings-page-spec.json`
- PRDs: `sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/retention-controls-prd.json`, `sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/compliance-reporting-pack-prd.json`
- Export format ADR: `sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-018-compliance-report-pack-export-format.json`
- Retention standards: `sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/infra-standards/data-deletion-and-ttl-enforcement-standards.json`

## Acceptance criteria
- Internal Confluence pages updated and linked from Security & Compliance index.
- External docs merged in `redwood-docs` with:
  - Clear tier-based defaults + how customers configure overrides
  - Explicit “in-scope” vs “out-of-scope” for v1
  - Correct explanation of legal hold/incident hold semantics (customer-friendly)
  - Instructions to download/request the baseline compliance reporting pack
- Security review checklist completed (Marcus Lin + Dr. Aisha Rahman sign-off).
- Sales/SE enablement links updated in Security FAQ (so AEs can share the right URLs).

## Security review checklist (docs-specific)
- [x] No promises beyond approved product behavior and contractual terms
- [x] Legal hold wording: who can apply, how it’s audited, and what it means for retention
- [x] Data classes list matches v1 implementation scope
- [x] “Deletion” semantics phrased correctly (purge jobs, eventual enforcement, verification)
- [x] Avoid exposing internal architecture details (store names, queue names, retention job thresholds)

## Rollout / publication plan
- External docs published once Console retention settings is behind feature flag for design partners.
- For early enterprise deals, share PDF/pack via Solutions Engineering while the in-console generation is rolling out; docs should reflect both options.

## Post-GA follow-ups (not in scope here)
- Add screenshots/gifs once UI is stable in GA build.
- Add “Private deployment” admin guide section for Terraform module usage and installer defaults.
- Add troubleshooting section keyed to retention verification dashboards (TTL lag, backlog, purge failures).
comments: 2025-02-10 — Naomi Feldman (PM): Please treat this as a release blocker for Northbridge/Helio security reviews. External docs can be “stubs” but must be precise on scope and wording.
2025-02-12 — Elliot Price (Docs): Drafted external pages outline; waiting on confirmation of tier default TTL table and min/max constraints language from Security/Platform.

2025-02-14 — Marcus Lin (SecEng): Strong preference to avoid “guaranteed deletion within X hours” language; use “scheduled purge jobs” + “verification metrics and audits” phrasing. Also ensure legal hold is explicitly auditable and restricted.

2025-02-20 — Sofia Mendes (Legal): Approved customer-facing legal hold phrasing: we may preserve relevant records under legal hold obligations; holds are applied via restricted workflow; we provide evidence upon request. Do not include internal approver list in external docs.

2025-02-26 — Kira Thompson (Tech Writer): Added Dedicated vs Private callouts and clarified that Private customers may manage storage/backups controls depending on deployment mode; included an explicit “responsibility boundary” section.

2025-03-03 — Kevin Osei (Eng): Confirmed retention config export endpoint naming and that change history is included; please link to Console flow and mention API availability for enterprise tiers only (until GA).

2025-03-07 — Dr. Aisha Rahman (CISO): Approved the doc set with minor edits: ensure “audit logs are immutable” is not stated globally; say “append-only event log with controlled access and export filters.”
2025-03-12 — Elliot Price (Docs): Merged `redwood-docs` PR and updated Confluence pages. Marking Done; screenshots will follow as a separate ticket once UI stabilizes.
